title: Works Great!
text: Works Great!. In my grown up years, I have always wanted to make fudge. I have never owned a candy thermometer, so I never ventured into that. Well, now there's nothing holding me back! The thermometer is a good size and much larger than the one I remembered my mom using. It's pretty easy to read, though I still have to put my reading glasses on. It works well which is the most important part!
